strongest_outsiders.name: Maria Island National Park
strongest_outsiders.note: Four kept places cluster here (park, Darlington, Fossil Cliffs, Painted Cliffs) but the park is the base itself, leaving three spots; three never make a destination and Maria Island is rank 3 at best, so all four stand alone. Owner option: propose Maria Island as an island destination (name_evidence: Wikivoyage 'Maria Island National Park', Parks Tasmania, Discover Tasmania) with the other three as its spots.
